openObjectives.prompt: Henrietta has your weekend open on the desk and it is, so far, blank. Tell Henrietta what you want to do this weekend, using Italian.
Tell Henrietta something that you have to do this week, using Italian.
Henrietta deals in the near future and would like yours in advance. Tell Henrietta what you are going to do tomorrow, using Italian.

character.name: Henrietta Tallow
character.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset in a uniform that belongs to a different job, holding a clipboard like a shield. Henrietta is a Fortune Teller, Strictly Short Range and sees as far as the weekend, in detail, and declines to speculate beyond it.

npc.narrative: You reach the Considerable Thicket on a clear mattina, where a small tenda leans against the largest cespuglio. Henrietta Tallow stands up so fast that her sedia goes over backwards. A cartello on the tenda says CLOSED, crossed out in a hurry.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Finalmente arriva un cliente. Io voglio vedere il tuo fine settimana, ma non dopo. Che cosa vuoi fare tu questo fine settimana?
npc.translation: Good morning! At last a customer is arriving. I want to see your weekend, but nothing after it. What do you want to do this weekend?

player: Buongiorno! Questo fine settimana voglio andare al mare con i miei amici. Tu vedi il sole o la pioggia?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You told Henrietta clearly that you want to go to the sea with your friends, and you even asked her a question back.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you said what you want to do this weekend with "voglio andare al mare".

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: Questo fine settimana voglio andare al mare con i miei amici.

objectiveResults.feedback: Not yet: Henrietta wants to hear something you have to do this week, so she will ask you again later.
Not yet: Henrietta wants to hear what you are planning to do tomorrow, so she will ask you again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Tell Henrietta something that you have to do this week, using Italian.
Henrietta deals in the near future and would like yours in advance. Tell Henrietta what you are going to do tomorrow, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Henrietta shuts her occhi and leans over the tavolo, reading the fine settimana like a very small menu. Her porta stands open, the sole is high, and the cielo is clear. Her caffè has been cold since the mattina, and she has not noticed.
npc.native: Il mare, con gli amici! Che bello. Io vedo il sole sabato, ma devo dire una cosa: domenica c'è vento. Che cosa devi fare tu questa settimana?
npc.translation: The sea, with your friends! How lovely. I see the sun on Saturday, but I must say one thing: on Sunday there is wind. What do you have to do this week?

player: Questa settimana devo lavorare molto, e devo pulire la casa. Che noia! Tu devi lavorare anche?

verdict.overallFeedback: Your Italian is lovely: you told Henrietta about your busy week with correct sentences, and you even asked her a question back. Next, you can tell her about tomorrow.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done: you said what you have to do this week in Italian, and you used it twice.

vocabularyEvidence.evidence: devo lavorare molto, e devo pulire la casa

objectiveResults.feedback: Not yet: this one asks you to tell Henrietta what you are thinking of doing tomorrow. Henrietta will ask you again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Henrietta deals in the near future and would like yours in advance. Tell Henrietta what you are going to do tomorrow, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Henrietta claps her mani and writes something on a small cartellino, which she then turns face down. Outside the tenda the sole stands high in a clear cielo, exactly as she apparently predicted on Tuesday.
npc.native: Pulire la casa, che fatica! Io lavoro ogni giorno, ma i clienti arrivano poco. Domani penso di restare qui con le mie carte. E tu, che cosa pensi di fare domani?
npc.translation: Cleaning the house, what a chore! I work every day, but the customers hardly come. Tomorrow I plan to stay here with my cards. And you, what are you thinking of doing tomorrow?

player: Domani andrò dal dentista. Non sono contento. Le tue carte dicono che va bene?

verdict.overallFeedback: Your Italian is correct, and you told Henrietta about the dentist, your mood and her cards. Next time, try saying your plan with \"penso di\", as she did.

objectiveResults.feedback: You told Henrietta your plan for tomorrow in good Italian, but the phrase for "I'm thinking of" is missing; try "Domani penso di andare dal dentista."

npc.narrative: Henrietta pulls the carte toward her across the tavolo, eager as a dog at a door. Outside the tenda the sole is high and the cielo is clear. One card has been face down since martedì, and nobody has asked about it.
npc.native: Il dentista, mi dispiace! Le carte dicono che domani va bene, e io penso di vedere una sedia molto scomoda. Dopo il dentista, che cosa pensi di fare?
npc.translation: The dentist, I am sorry! The cards say that tomorrow goes well, and I think I see a very uncomfortable chair. After the dentist, what do you plan to do?

player: Dopo il dentista mangerò un gelato, per essere felice. Ma... c'è una carta sotto. Cosa dice?

npc.narrative: You lean over the tavolo, where one carta sits under the others like a guest who arrived presto. Henrietta lifts it with two dita, holds it up to the sole and reads it with the face of someone opening a biglietto from a cugino.
npc.native: Un gelato, che buona idea! La carta sotto dice: gelato al limone, sabato, vicino al mare. Io vedo anche un cono molto piccolo. Che gusto di gelato ti piace di più?
npc.translation: An ice cream, what a good idea! The card underneath says: lemon ice cream, Saturday, near the sea. I also see a very small cone. Which ice cream flavour do you like best?

player: Io preferisco il pistacchio, non il limone! Le carte sbagliano? E un cono piccolo, no, voglio grande!

npc.narrative: Henrietta gathers the carte with one dito, piano, as if they were ancora offended. Under the tavolo a gatto sleeps on her borsa. Fuori, the piazza is quiet and the sole stands alto.
npc.native: Il pistacchio, che gusto serio! Le carte non sbagliano, ma vedono solo fino a domenica. Io vedo un cono grande, con due palline verdi. Con chi mangi il gelato?
npc.translation: Pistachio, what a serious flavour! The cards do not make mistakes, but they only see as far as Sunday. I see a big cone, with two green scoops. Who do you eat the ice cream with?

player: Con la mia ragazza. Grazie Henrietta, devo andare al lavoro. Ciao, a presto!

npc.narrative: Henrietta drags her sedia closer and writes on the back of a carta, subito, as if the words might leave without her. Under the tenda the sole stands straight overhead, and the strada is tranquilla except for one cane tapping somewhere.
npc.native: Con la tua ragazza, che bello! Le tue ultime parole sono per la mia collezione, e ne manca solo una. Io vedo due cucchiaini nel gelato. Che lavoro fai tu?
npc.translation: With your girlfriend, how lovely! Your last words are for my collection, and only one is missing. I see two little spoons in the ice cream. What job do you do?
